preconditions.description: The number of boxes is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The index of the box that got the last ball is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each box contains between 0 and 10^9 balls, inclusive.
The box with index x has at least one ball.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, representing the initial number of balls in each box.

postconditions.expression: output[i-1] is the initial number of balls in the box number i
postconditions.description: The i-th integer in the output corresponds to the initial number of balls in the box number i.
